products.name: NovaFlow Pulse
products.tagline: Unified pipeline health, cohort NRR tracking, and board-ready revenue forecasting.
key_features: Real-time ARR, GRR, and NRR waterfall dashboards
Automated cohort retention and expansion tracking
CRM hygiene anomaly detection across Salesforce and HubSpot
pain_points_solved: Conflicting ARR numbers between Finance spreadsheets and Sales CRM reports
Weeks wasted manually reconciling Stripe/Chargebee invoices with CRM deals
Late visibility into contraction trends before quarter close

products.name: NovaFlow Retain
products.tagline: Explainable 90-day churn prediction and automated save playbooks.
key_features: Explainable account-level churn probability scores 90 days ahead of renewal
Product telemetry drop-off and champion-churn alerts
Automated Slack and CRM escalation playbooks for at-risk accounts
Expansion readiness scoring for seat and tier upsells
pain_points_solved: Customer Success teams learning about churn risk only during the renewal call
Subjective red/yellow/green account health scores with no predictive accuracy
Missed expansion revenue in accounts hitting usage ceilings

products.name: NovaFlow Sync
products.tagline: 48-hour unified revenue data model with EU/US residency controls.
key_features: Pre-built identity resolution linking billing accounts, CRM orgs, and product workspaces
SOC 2 Type II and Frankfurt EU GDPR data residency isolation
pain_points_solved: 6-month data engineering backlogs blocking RevOps analytics initiatives
Broken customer ID mappings across billing, support, and product systems
EMEA procurement blockers around US-only data hosting

pricing_tiers.ideal_for: Series B SaaS teams ($10M-$25M ARR) consolidating CRM and billing reporting.
Mid-market SaaS and subscription brands ($25M-$75M ARR) reducing churn and driving NRR.
Multi-product or EMEA-regulated enterprises ($75M+ ARR) requiring custom SLAs and EU residency.
